top_diagnoses.reasoning_summary: Patient presented with asymptomatic left-sided hydronephrosis, which progressed to worsening intermittent left loin pain and significant cortical thinning. Radiological findings and histopathological examination revealed characteristics consistent with Retroperitoneal Fibrosis, including thickening of fascial planes, fibrosis, and inflammatory cells. Immunohistochemistry showed positivity for smooth muscle actin, vimentin, and CD34.
